changes: packages/main/src/tasks/gap-analyze.ts treats DONE and DISCARDED as terminal phases for convergence story completion; packages/main/src/handlers/summary.ts now has complete task annotation metadata; packages/main/src/tasks/convergence-discarded-smoke.ts plus package script cover the regression.
usage: Run npm run build, npm run test:convergence-false-blockers, npm run test:e2e, or koala convergence_check to verify the false blockers are gone.
limitations: The 10 historical high-priority gaps are intentionally still reported; this story only removes false blockers from DISCARDED stories and summary annotation metadata.
pitfalls: REVIEW required all five reviewer lanes including docs even for an internal-only fix, and low/happy findings had to be resolved before TEST.
